users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts, their roles and branch access
users.scopesHint: Limits the tickets and customers the user sees. Leave empty when a role grants access to all branches.
users.noScopeWarning: None of the selected roles grants access to all branches. Without a scope this user will see no tickets or customers.
users.resetPasswordHint: Sets a new password and signs the user out of every session.
users.resetPasswordMessage: {{name}} will have to sign in again with the new password.
users.activateMessage: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
users.deactivateMessage: {{name}} will be signed out and can no longer sign in.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Permission sets assigned to users
roles.deleteMessage: The role "{{name}}" will be deleted permanently.

organization.title: Organization
organization.subtitle: Profile, branding and branch structure
organization.profileReadOnly: You can view the profile and branding. Changing them needs the settings permission.
organization.logoHint: PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP, up to 2 MB.
organization.logoType: The logo must be a PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP image.
organization.logoTooLarge: The logo must be 2 MB or smaller.
organization.branchesReadOnly: Read only: changing branches needs the organization permission.
organization.deactivateBranchMessage: The branch "{{name}}" will no longer be available for new tickets and users.
organization.deactivateDepartmentMessage: The department "{{name}}" will no longer be available for new tickets and users.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Feature toggles and system limits
settings.publicHint: Visible to the login page and the customer portal.
settings.numberRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

portal.registration_enabled: Customers can create their own portal account.

chat.enabled: Shows the live chat widget to customers.

webform.enabled: Accepts tickets from the public contact form.

chatbot.enabled: Answers customers automatically before a human joins.

ai.agent_assist_enabled: Suggested replies, summaries and categories for agents.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: API keys for external systems and outgoing webhooks
integrations.apiKeysHint: External systems authenticate with these keys. Grant only the scopes they need.
integrations.expiresHint: Leave empty for a key that never expires.
integrations.revokeMessage: Systems using "{{name}}" will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
integrations.apiKeySecretHint: Store this key securely in the external system.
integrations.webhooksHint: Events are sent as signed HTTPS POST requests.
integrations.webhookSecretHint: Use this signing secret to verify the signature of each delivery.
integrations.rotateMessage: The current secret of "{{name}}" stops working immediately. Update the receiver with the new one.
integrations.deleteWebhookMessage: "{{name}}" and its delivery history will be deleted.
integrations.secretOnce: This value is shown only once. Copy it now; it cannot be displayed again.
integrations.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what and when
audit.empty: No audit entries match the filters.
audit.exportHint: The CSV export applies only the date range and action filters.
